title: Send incidents beyond this device
description: Connect an HTTPS receiver for the store. Puntovivo signs each minimal alert and keeps the delivery result visible here.
honesty: This is software delivery to a receiver you provide. It is not a staffed monitoring service, an on-call team, or a response-time guarantee.

create.title: Connect an alert receiver
create.description: Use an HTTPS endpoint owned by your organization or monitoring provider. No alert is reported as sent until this connection exists.
create.name: Receiver name
create.error: The receiver could not be connected. Verify the public HTTPS address and try again.

secret.title: Save this signing secret now
secret.description: It is shown once. Configure it in the receiver to verify that alerts came from this store.

incidents.title: Incident acknowledgement
incidents.description: Marking an incident as seen records who reviewed it. The underlying problem stays visible until it is actually resolved.
incidents.empty: No operational incident has been recorded yet.

deliveries.title: Delivery evidence
deliveries.description: Only status codes and bounded error codes are retained; credentials, response bodies, and business records are not stored here.
deliveries.empty: No alert delivery has been attempted.

retention: Attempt evidence is kept for {{attemptDays}} days and resolved incident history for {{historyDays}} days.
loadError: The external alert status could not be loaded.
